name: Helmets
notes: Published source prices include Japanese consumption tax.
When adding an extra visor during a complete full-face or open-face helmet service, the additional charge is ₱418 per visor.
Application may not be possible on hand-painted or non-original painted surfaces.
Application may not be possible when water repellent, paint, or another treatment is present on the visor.
Only clear and smoked visors are eligible. Modified visors cannot be treated.
Application may not be possible when the helmet shell is severely deteriorated.
Advanced preparation such as correcting minor marks may incur additional charges.
Existing-item amounts in this list are minimum prices.
